subject: general
question: Where is the headquarters of SIDBI (Small Industries Development Bank of India) as of February 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lucknow**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Small Industries Development Bank of India
 
• It is the apex regulatory body for overall licensing and regulation of micro, small and medium enterprise finance companies in India.
 
• It is under the jurisdiction of Ministry of Finance.
 
• Its headquartered at **Lucknow **and having its offices all over the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• It was founded on **2 April 1990.**
 
• SIDBI is headed by the Chairman & Managing Director.
 
• The SIDBI is operating different programmes and schemes through 5 Regional Offices and 33 Branch Offices.
 
• As of March 31, 2008, the Reserve Bank regulated EXIM Bank, the National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD), the National Housing Bank (NHB), and the Small Industries Development Bank of India as development finance institutions (SIDBI).
